credit: Footage: IO Interactive (007 First Light Gameplay Trailer)

beats.say: James Bond is up for Game of the Year.
007 First Light just got a Game Awards nomination.
It comes from IO Interactive, the Hitman studio.
You play a young, reckless Bond in MI6 training.
It was delayed from March to May 27.
Now it faces GTA 6 for the top prize.
GTA 6 leads the show with 8 nominations.
Resident Evil Requiem and Zelda are in too.
So, could Bond beat Vice City?
